jp: 地獄のような暑さの火口に生育し、その熱気に揺れる一輪の花。高熱がエネルギー源で、余剰熱は火炎魔法として排出する。さすがに溶岩を浴びると焼けるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "地獄のような暑さの火口に生育し、その熱気に揺れる一輪の花。高熱がエネルギー源で、余剰熱は火炎魔法として排出する。さすがに溶岩を浴びると焼けるようだ。"
en: A single flower that grows in the crater of hellish heat and sways in the heat of it. High heat is the source of energy and the excess heat is expelled as flame magic. As expected it seems to burn when exposed to lava.
en_grezzo: "A single flower that grows in the crater of hellish heat and sways in the heat of it. High heat is the source of energy and the excess heat is expelled as flame magic. As expected it seems to burn when exposed to lava."
it: Un fiore solitario che cresce dentro crateri caldi come l'inferno e ondeggia in quella vampa. Il calore altissimo è la sua fonte di energia, e quello che gli avanza lo butta fuori sotto forma di magia del fuoco. Se però gli si rovescia addosso della lava, allora sì che brucia.

jp: 鉱物を飲みこんで体内で弾丸を生成し、口から吐き出す。それだけなら大したことはないのだが、噛みついた状態で接射してくることもあるので接近するのは危険。
jp_grezzo: "鉱物を飲みこんで体内で弾丸を生成し、口から吐き出す。それだけなら大したことはないのだが、噛みついた状態で接射してくることもあるので接近するのは危険。"
en: It swallows the minerals produces bullets in its body and spits them out of its mouth. If that's all it's no big deal but it's dangerous to approach them because they may shoot at you while biting you.
en_grezzo: "It swallows the minerals produces bullets in its body and spits them out of its mouth. If that's all it's no big deal but it's dangerous to approach them because they may shoot at you while biting you."
it: Ingoia minerali, dentro il corpo se ne fabbrica pallottole e le sputa dalla bocca. Se fosse solo questo non sarebbe granché, ma capita che spari a bruciapelo mentre ti tiene addentato: avvicinarsi è pericoloso.

jp: 主に砂地に生息する砂虫だが、地面に潜っている間に迷子になってしまい、場違いな場所に顔を出してしまうことがある。図体の割に動きが俊敏で、一瞬で穴に潜り一瞬で顔を出す。
jp_grezzo: "主に砂地に生息する砂虫だが、地面に潜っている間に迷子になってしまい、場違いな場所に顔を出してしまうことがある。図体の割に動きが俊敏で、一瞬で穴に潜り一瞬で顔を出す。"
en: They are mainly sand bugs that live in sandy areas but they can get lost while burrowing on the ground and show their faces in out-of-place places. They move quickly for their size diving into a hole in an instant and coming out of it in an instant.
en_grezzo: "They are mainly sand bugs that live in sandy areas but they can get lost while burrowing on the ground and show their faces in out-of-place places. They move quickly for their size diving into a hole in an instant and coming out of it in an instant."
it: È un verme di sabbia e vive soprattutto sui terreni sabbiosi, ma mentre se ne va sottoterra capita che si perda e che spunti fuori in posti dove non c'entra niente. Per la mole che ha si muove svelto: in un attimo si infila nel buco e in un attimo rimette fuori la testa.

jp: 手が付けられないほどに狂暴な巨大イノシシ。美食家で美味しい作物ばかりを狙うため、こいつが畑にやってきたことを自慢する農家もいたりする。
jp_grezzo: "手が付けられないほどに狂暴な巨大イノシシ。美食家で美味しい作物ばかりを狙うため、こいつが畑にやってきたことを自慢する農家もいたりする。"
en: A giant wild boar so frenzied that it can't be touched. Some farmers are proud of the fact that this guy has come to their fields because gourmets aim for only delicious crops.
en_grezzo: "A giant wild boar so frenzied that it can't be touched. Some farmers are proud of the fact that this guy has come to their fields because gourmets aim for only delicious crops."
it: Un cinghiale gigantesco e talmente furioso che non c'è verso di tenerlo. È un buongustaio e punta soltanto ai raccolti buoni, tanto che c'è perfino qualche contadino che si vanta di averlo visto nel proprio campo.

jp: 巨大な野獣。特殊な力は何も持っていないが、助走をつけてからの突進が十分すぎる威力なのだ。突進力だけかと思いきや、機敏で小回りが利く。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な野獣。特殊な力は何も持っていないが、助走をつけてからの突進が十分すぎる威力なのだ。突進力だけかと思いきや、機敏で小回りが利く。"
en: A giant beast. He has no special powers but his rush after he puts on his main run is more than powerful enough. It's agile and can turn swiftly.
en_grezzo: "A giant beast. He has no special powers but his rush after he puts on his main run is more than powerful enough. It's agile and can turn swiftly."
it: Una bestia selvatica enorme. Poteri particolari non ne ha nessuno, ma quando prende la rincorsa e carica la potenza è più che sufficiente. E chi lo credesse buono solo a caricare si sbaglia: è svelto e gira stretto.

jp: 縞々が可愛いイノシシの子供。これが成長してあんな猛獣になるとは思えない。子供といえど、一撃離脱の突進は見事なもの。
jp_grezzo: "縞々が可愛いイノシシの子供。これが成長してあんな猛獣になるとは思えない。子供といえど、一撃離脱の突進は見事なもの。"
en: A wild boar cub with cute stripes. I don't think this thing will grow up and become such a ferocious beast. Even though he is a child the rush of a one-shot release is masterful.
en_grezzo: "A wild boar cub with cute stripes. I don't think this thing will grow up and become such a ferocious beast. Even though he is a child the rush of a one-shot release is masterful."
it: Un cinghiale piccolo, con certe righe che sono una tenerezza. Non si direbbe che crescendo diventi quella bestiaccia. Anche se è un cucciolo, il modo in cui carica e si sfila subito dopo è da manuale.

jp: 他の動物が食べないような物を餌とする方向で進化を続けた結果、最終的に暗黒物質を食すようになった。食べてもほとんど分解できないため体内は真っ黒。闇夜に集団で行進する。
jp_grezzo: "他の動物が食べないような物を餌とする方向で進化を続けた結果、最終的に暗黒物質を食すようになった。食べてもほとんど分解できないため体内は真っ黒。闇夜に集団で行進する。"
en: It continued to evolve in the direction of feeding on things that other animals would not and eventually came to eat dark matter. It is almost impossible to break down even if eaten so the body is black. They march in groups in the dark.
en_grezzo: "It continued to evolve in the direction of feeding on things that other animals would not and eventually came to eat dark matter. It is almost impossible to break down even if eaten so the body is black. They march in groups in the dark."
it: Si è evoluto continuando a puntare su quello che gli altri animali non mangiano, e alla fine è arrivato a nutrirsi di materia oscura. Mangiarla la mangia, ma digerirla quasi per niente, e per questo dentro è nero come la pece. Nelle notti senza luna marcia in gruppo.

jp: 優秀な魔法使いの家系に生まれ、才能にも恵まれた少女。エウダーナの実力主義教育もあってすっかり増長してしまった。箒乗りスタイルを流行らせようとしているが進捗はイマイチ。
jp_grezzo: "優秀な魔法使いの家系に生まれ、才能にも恵まれた少女。エウダーナの実力主義教育もあってすっかり増長してしまった。箒乗りスタイルを流行らせようとしているが進捗はイマイチ。"
en: A girl born into a family of talented wizards she is also blessed with talent. This has been greatly enhanced by the meritocratic education in Eulderna. She's trying to popularize the broom riding style but she's not making much progress.
en_grezzo: "A girl born into a family of talented wizards she is also blessed with talent. This has been greatly enhanced by the meritocratic education in Eulderna. She's trying to popularize the broom riding style but she's not making much progress."
it: Una ragazza nata in una famiglia di ottimi maghi, e col talento in dote pure lei. Fra questo e l'istruzione di Eulderna, che premia solo chi vale, le è montata la testa per bene. Sta cercando di lanciare la moda di andare in scopa, ma finora i risultati sono scarsini.

jp: かつて最強であったエウダーナの魔導士。現在は痴呆で魔法の大部分が使えない。だが今でも上級魔導士を凌駕する魔力を持っており、エウダーナ王も彼には敬意を払うとされる。
jp_grezzo: "かつて最強であったエウダーナの魔導士。現在は痴呆で魔法の大部分が使えない。だが今でも上級魔導士を凌駕する魔力を持っており、エウダーナ王も彼には敬意を払うとされる。"
en: He was once the strongest mage of Eulderna. He is currently unable to use most of his magic due to dementia. Even now however he still possesses magical powers that surpass those of advanced mages and it is said that the King of Eulderna respects him.
en_grezzo: "He was once the strongest mage of Eulderna. He is currently unable to use most of his magic due to dementia. Even now however he still possesses magical powers that surpass those of advanced mages and it is said that the King of Eulderna respects him."
it: Fu il più forte incantatore di Eulderna. Adesso è caduto in demenza e la maggior parte delle sue magie non le sa più usare. Eppure il potere magico che si ritrova supera ancora quello di un incantatore di grado alto, e si dice che perfino il re di Eulderna gli porti rispetto.

jp: 粗末にされた栗たちが恨みを晴らすため寄り集まって巨人に化けた姿。強固な肉体を持ち、火を浴びても熱ではじけたりはしない。仲間想いな性格で、栗をぶつけられると心が痛む。
jp_grezzo: "粗末にされた栗たちが恨みを晴らすため寄り集まって巨人に化けた姿。強固な肉体を持ち、火を浴びても熱ではじけたりはしない。仲間想いな性格で、栗をぶつけられると心が痛む。"
en: Chestnuts that were mistreated gather together to get rid of their resentment and transform themselves into giants. It has a strong body and does not burst from the heat even when exposed to fire. It has a companionate nature and its heart aches when it hits another chestnut.
en_grezzo: "Chestnuts that were mistreated gather together to get rid of their resentment and transform themselves into giants. It has a strong body and does not burst from the heat even when exposed to fire. It has a companionate nature and its heart aches when it hits another chestnut."
it: Sono castagne trattate male che si sono radunate per prendersi la rivincita e si sono trasformate in un gigante. Ha un corpo robusto, e se lo si mette sul fuoco non scoppia per il calore. Tiene ai suoi simili, e quando gli tirano addosso una castagna ci soffre.

jp: 本職は用心棒だが、それだけでは食っていけずに家庭教師も兼業している。特技はエビ反りと剣術。口調こそ丁寧だがリアクションが少々大げさ。
jp_grezzo: "本職は用心棒だが、それだけでは食っていけずに家庭教師も兼業している。特技はエビ反りと剣術。口調こそ丁寧だがリアクションが少々大げさ。"
en: He is a bouncer by profession but he can't make a living by himself so he also works as a tutor. His special skills are shrimp warping and swordsmanship. His tone is polite but his reaction is a little exaggerated.
en_grezzo: "He is a bouncer by profession but he can't make a living by himself so he also works as a tutor. His special skills are shrimp warping and swordsmanship. His tone is polite but his reaction is a little exaggerated."
it: Di mestiere fa il guardaspalle, ma di quello solo non si campa e allora arrotonda dando ripetizioni a domicilio. Le sue specialità sono l'inarcamento a gambero e la scherma. Parla in modo educatissimo, però reagisce a tutto un po' troppo.

jp: トリュフと呼ばれる、きのこによく似たチョコレートに魂が宿った。食べられるために生み出されたことは認識しているが、その運命を素直に受け入れられずにいる。
jp_grezzo: "トリュフと呼ばれる、きのこによく似たチョコレートに魂が宿った。食べられるために生み出されたことは認識しているが、その運命を素直に受け入れられずにいる。"
en: The soul is in a mushroom-like chocolate called a truffle which looks a lot like a mushroom. They are aware that they were created to be eaten but they are unable to accept their fate meekly.
en_grezzo: "The soul is in a mushroom-like chocolate called a truffle which looks a lot like a mushroom. They are aware that they were created to be eaten but they are unable to accept their fate meekly."
it: In un cioccolatino che somiglia molto a un fungo, e che per questo chiamano tartufo, si è insediata un'anima. Sa benissimo di essere stato fatto per essere mangiato, ma quel destino non riesce ad accettarlo di buon grado.

jp: 知識を司る中級神。かつて起きた神々の大戦、その一部始終を知る数少ない神族。元素の神とは祖父と孫のように親密であり、追放者は彼女がモデルだとされる。
jp_grezzo: "知識を司る中級神。かつて起きた神々の大戦、その一部始終を知る数少ない神族。元素の神とは祖父と孫のように親密であり、追放者は彼女がモデルだとされる。"
en: A mid-level god who presides over knowledge. There are few gods who know the whole story of the war between the gods. She is as intimate with the elemental god as grandfather and granddaughter and the exile is said to be modeled after her.
en_grezzo: "A mid-level god who presides over knowledge. There are few gods who know the whole story of the war between the gods. She is as intimate with the elemental god as grandfather and granddaughter and the exile is said to be modeled after her."
it: La divinità di medio rango che ha in mano la conoscenza. È una dei pochi del ceppo divino a sapere per intero come andò la grande guerra fra gli dei. Col dio degli elementi è in confidenza come una nipote col nonno, e dicono che su di lei sia modellato l'esiliato.

jp: エウダーナ国民の中でも飛びぬけて知識欲が高い。高位の魔法こそ使えないが、魔法を体系づけたのは魔法使いではなく学者である。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナ国民の中でも飛びぬけて知識欲が高い。高位の魔法こそ使えないが、魔法を体系づけたのは魔法使いではなく学者である。"
en: He has an unparalleled thirst for knowledge among the people of Euldera. It is not the wizard who systematized magic but the scholar although higher-level magic is not available to them.
en_grezzo: "He has an unparalleled thirst for knowledge among the people of Euldera. It is not the wizard who systematized magic but the scholar although higher-level magic is not available to them."
it: Perfino fra i cittadini di Eulderna la sua sete di sapere spicca su tutte. Le magie di grado alto non sa usarle, però a mettere in ordine la magia e a farne un sistema non sono stati i maghi: sono stati gli eruditi.

jp: 異形の森出身。エーテルが蟲に与える影響の研究をしている学者であるが、狂暴な蟲と日々、文字通り格闘しているため戦闘力は高い。一児の母で最近は娘に嫌われまいと必死。
jp_grezzo: "異形の森出身。エーテルが蟲に与える影響の研究をしている学者であるが、狂暴な蟲と日々、文字通り格闘しているため戦闘力は高い。一児の母で最近は娘に嫌われまいと必死。"
en: A native of the strange forest. She is a scholar who is studying the effects of ether on bugs but her fighting power is high because she literally wrestles with violent bugs every day. A mother of one she is desperate not to be hated by her daughter these days.
en_grezzo: "A native of the strange forest. She is a scholar who is studying the effects of ether on bugs but her fighting power is high because she literally wrestles with violent bugs every day. A mother of one she is desperate not to be hated by her daughter these days."
it: Viene dalla Foresta Eretica. È una studiosa e si occupa degli effetti dell'etere sugli insetti, ma dato che ogni giorno finisce alle prese con insetti furiosi, e alle prese alla lettera, in combattimento se la cava benissimo. Ha una figlia, e ultimamente farebbe qualunque cosa pur di non farsi odiare da lei.

jp: マリアに連れられて森を駆け回り、研究を手伝うのが日課。最近反抗的だが、内心ではマリアをとても慕っている。甘いものが大好きだがイモムシなども普通に食す。
jp_grezzo: "マリアに連れられて森を駆け回り、研究を手伝うのが日課。最近反抗的だが、内心ではマリアをとても慕っている。甘いものが大好きだがイモムシなども普通に食す。"
en: She runs around the forest with Mary to help her with her research. She has been rebellious lately but deep down she loves Mary very much. She loves sweets but she also usually eats caterpillars.
en_grezzo: "She runs around the forest with Mary to help her with her research. She has been rebellious lately but deep down she loves Mary very much. She loves sweets but she also usually eats caterpillars."
it: Ogni giorno gira il bosco al seguito di Mary e le dà una mano con la ricerca. Ultimamente fa un po' la ribelle, ma dentro di sé a Mary vuole un bene dell'anima. Va matta per i dolci, e comunque i bruchi e simili se li mangia senza farsi problemi.

jp: 富の女神に使い走りにされているうちに基本的な商売技術を身に着けた、賢いカラス。光り物だろうが惑わされずに価値を確かめるくらいの知能がある。
jp_grezzo: "富の女神に使い走りにされているうちに基本的な商売技術を身に着けた、賢いカラス。光り物だろうが惑わされずに価値を確かめるくらいの知能がある。"
en: A clever crow who learned basic business skills while being sent on an errand by the goddess of wealth. They are intelligent enough to see the value without being misled even if it is a shiny object.
en_grezzo: "A clever crow who learned basic business skills while being sent on an errand by the goddess of wealth. They are intelligent enough to see the value without being misled even if it is a shiny object."
it: Un corvo furbo, che a furia di essere mandato in giro a fare commissioni dalla dea della ricchezza ha imparato i rudimenti del mestiere. È abbastanza sveglio da valutare quanto vale una cosa senza lasciarsi abbagliare, e sì che parliamo di un corvo e di roba che luccica.

jp: 「ケサランパサランは幸運をもたらす」という迷信によって人間たちの欲望を一身に受け続けた結果、いつしか黒く汚れてしまった毛玉の妖怪。心もすっかり荒んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "「ケサランパサランは幸運をもたらす」という迷信によって人間たちの欲望を一身に受け続けた結果、いつしか黒く汚れてしまった毛玉の妖怪。心もすっかり荒んでいる。"
en: As a result of the superstition that Kesalanpatharan brings good fortune they have been subjected to the desires of humans and as a result they have become blackened and stained. Its mind is in a state of total disarray.
en_grezzo: "As a result of the superstition that Kesalanpatharan brings good fortune they have been subjected to the desires of humans and as a result they have become blackened and stained. Its mind is in a state of total disarray."
it: È un batuffolo stregato che si è preso addosso, tutta intera e per anni, l'avidità degli uomini, per via della superstizione secondo cui il kesaranpasaran porta fortuna. Alla fine si è annerito e insudiciato, e anche dentro gli si è inasprito tutto.

jp: 毛玉の妖怪。風の強い日には飛ばされまいと必死な姿を見ることが出来る。視線媒体魔法を使うため襲われた際には相手を睨みつけるが、目が小さすぎて睨んでいるのか分からない。
jp_grezzo: "毛玉の妖怪。風の強い日には飛ばされまいと必死な姿を見ることが出来る。視線媒体魔法を使うため襲われた際には相手を睨みつけるが、目が小さすぎて睨んでいるのか分からない。"
en: The hairball specter. On a windy day they can be seen desperately trying not to be blown away. They glare at their opponents when they are attacked because they use line-of-sight medium magic but their eyes are too small to tell if they are glaring.
en_grezzo: "The hairball specter. On a windy day they can be seen desperately trying not to be blown away. They glare at their opponents when they are attacked because they use line-of-sight medium magic but their eyes are too small to tell if they are glaring."
it: Un batuffolo di pelo stregato. Nei giorni di vento lo si vede aggrapparsi con tutte le sue forze per non farsi portare via. La sua magia passa per lo sguardo, e quindi quando lo assalgono fulmina l'avversario con gli occhi, ma li ha così piccoli che non si capisce se stia fulminando qualcuno o no.

jp: 蟻のような巨大生物の親玉。ものすごい勢いで大量の酸を浴びせてくる。子供がいっぱいいすぎて全員の顔を識別することを諦めている。
jp_grezzo: "蟻のような巨大生物の親玉。ものすごい勢いで大量の酸を浴びせてくる。子供がいっぱいいすぎて全員の顔を識別することを諦めている。"
en: The parent of the ant-like giant creature. It sprays you with a lot of acid at a tremendous rate. There are too many kids and they have given up on identifying everyone's face.
en_grezzo: "The parent of the ant-like giant creature. It sprays you with a lot of acid at a tremendous rate. There are too many kids and they have given up on identifying everyone's face."
it: È la capostipite di quegli esseri giganteschi simili a formiche. Ti rovescia addosso acido a litri e a una velocità impressionante. Di figli ne ha talmente tanti che ha rinunciato a riconoscerli tutti in faccia.

jp: 蟻のような巨大生物。地雷侍たちと交流を深めるうち、色々あってサムライ魂に目覚めた。役目を果たせないと悟るとおもむろに自害しようとする。奴隷狩りなどは行わない。
jp_grezzo: "蟻のような巨大生物。地雷侍たちと交流を深めるうち、色々あってサムライ魂に目覚めた。役目を果たせないと悟るとおもむろに自害しようとする。奴隷狩りなどは行わない。"
en: Giant ant-like creatures. As a result of his interactions with the Jirai samurai he was awakened to his samurai spirit. When he realizes that he can't fulfill his role he boldly tries to kill himself. There will be no slave-hunting.
en_grezzo: "Giant ant-like creatures. As a result of his interactions with the Jirai samurai he was awakened to his samurai spirit. When he realizes that he can't fulfill his role he boldly tries to kill himself. There will be no slave-hunting."
it: Un essere gigantesco simile a una formica. A furia di frequentare i samurai kamikaze, fra una cosa e l'altra le si è risvegliato dentro lo spirito del samurai. Quando capisce di non poter più fare la sua parte, senza dire niente cerca di darsi la morte. Alla caccia agli schiavi e simili non partecipa.

jp: 蟻のような巨大生物。暗い所では視認しづらい。エサとなる人間や動物を毎日せっせと運ぶ、働き者の女の子たち。甘いものに目が無いという可愛い一面も。
jp_grezzo: "蟻のような巨大生物。暗い所では視認しづらい。エサとなる人間や動物を毎日せっせと運ぶ、働き者の女の子たち。甘いものに目が無いという可愛い一面も。"
en: Giant ant-like creatures. It is difficult to see in the dark. These hard-working girls work hard every day to bring in people and animals to feed themselves. She also has a cute side in that she has an eye for sweets.
en_grezzo: "Giant ant-like creatures. It is difficult to see in the dark. These hard-working girls work hard every day to bring in people and animals to feed themselves. She also has a cute side in that she has an eye for sweets."
it: Un essere gigantesco simile a una formica. Al buio è difficile accorgersi che c'è. Sono ragazze gran lavoratrici, che ogni giorno si sfiancano a trascinare a casa uomini e animali da mangiare. E hanno anche un lato tenero: per i dolci vanno matte.

jp: エウダーナから奪った試作魔導アイテムと融合した兵士。10人に8人の割合で融合段階において適合できずにマナの流れがおかしくなって死ぬという。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナから奪った試作魔導アイテムと融合した兵士。10人に8人の割合で融合段階において適合できずにマナの流れがおかしくなって死ぬという。"
en: A soldier fused with a prototype magic item taken from Eulderna; 8 out of every 10 people die when their mana flow goes haywire due to failure to adapt during the fusion phase.
en_grezzo: "A soldier fused with a prototype magic item taken from Eulderna; 8 out of every 10 people die when their mana flow goes haywire due to failure to adapt during the fusion phase."
it: Un soldato fuso con un oggetto magico sperimentale rubato a Eulderna. Dicono che 8 su 10 non reggano la fase della fusione: il flusso del mana gli va per traverso, e muoiono.

jp: 冥界の力を操る蟹。死者の魂を食らうとされており、魂を食われると蘇生魔法でも蘇生できなくなるという風説がある。冥界ドラゴンとは共生関係にある。
jp_grezzo: "冥界の力を操る蟹。死者の魂を食らうとされており、魂を食われると蘇生魔法でも蘇生できなくなるという風説がある。冥界ドラゴンとは共生関係にある。"
en: A crab that controls the power of the underworld. It is believed that the souls of the dead are eaten and it is said that if a person's soul is eaten he or she cannot be revived even by resurrection magic. It has a symbiotic relationship with the Underworld Dragon.
en_grezzo: "A crab that controls the power of the underworld. It is believed that the souls of the dead are eaten and it is said that if a person's soul is eaten he or she cannot be revived even by resurrection magic. It has a symbiotic relationship with the Underworld Dragon."
it: Un granchio che comanda la forza dell'oltretomba. Si crede che divori le anime dei morti, e gira voce che a chi si è fatto mangiare l'anima non lo riporti indietro nemmeno la magia di resurrezione. Col drago dell'oltretomba vive in simbiosi.

jp: 竜の呪いにより身体の半分以上が変容してしまっており、それを隠すため露出の低い服を選んでいる。竜族への憎しみは強く、狩場にされた竜窟からはドラゴンがいなくなったほど。
jp_grezzo: "竜の呪いにより身体の半分以上が変容してしまっており、それを隠すため露出の低い服を選んでいる。竜族への憎しみは強く、狩場にされた竜窟からはドラゴンがいなくなったほど。"
en: More than half of her body has been transformed by the dragon's curse and she chooses low-exposure clothing to hide it. Her hatred of the dragon tribe is so strong that the dragon cave has been turned into a hunting ground.
en_grezzo: "More than half of her body has been transformed by the dragon's curse and she chooses low-exposure clothing to hide it. Her hatred of the dragon tribe is so strong that the dragon cave has been turned into a hunting ground."
it: La maledizione del drago le ha trasformato più di metà del corpo, e per nasconderlo sceglie vestiti che coprono tutto. L'odio per la stirpe dei draghi ce l'ha così forte che dalla Tana del Drago, dopo che se l'è presa come riserva di caccia, i draghi sono spariti.

jp: 女神の欠片を宿す魔物。下半身は蛇になっており、体温が低いとうまく動かない。そのため大気から熱を奪い取り活動するのだが、その副産物として冷気を生み出し攻撃に転用する。
jp_grezzo: "女神の欠片を宿す魔物。下半身は蛇になっており、体温が低いとうまく動かない。そのため大気から熱を奪い取り活動するのだが、その副産物として冷気を生み出し攻撃に転用する。"
en: A demon possessing a piece of the goddess. His lower body is a snake and he can't move well when his body temperature is low. As a byproduct it creates cold air which it uses to attack.
en_grezzo: "A demon possessing a piece of the goddess. His lower body is a snake and he can't move well when his body temperature is low. As a byproduct it creates cold air which it uses to attack."
it: Un mostro che porta dentro di sé una scheggia della dea. Ha il corpo dalla cintola in giù di serpente, e col freddo non riesce a muoversi bene. Per questo ruba il calore all'aria per potersi muovere, e come sottoprodotto genera gelo, che gli torna utile per attaccare.

jp: 女神の欠片を宿す半人半蛇の姿の魔物。予言と引き換えに生贄を求めるが、気に入った生贄は生かして下僕として傍に置いておく。
jp_grezzo: "女神の欠片を宿す半人半蛇の姿の魔物。予言と引き換えに生贄を求めるが、気に入った生贄は生かして下僕として傍に置いておく。"
en: A demon in the form of a half-human half-snake that possesses a piece of a goddess. In exchange for the prophecy it asks for a sacrifice but keeps the one it likes alive and by its side as a servant.
en_grezzo: "A demon in the form of a half-human half-snake that possesses a piece of a goddess. In exchange for the prophecy it asks for a sacrifice but keeps the one it likes alive and by its side as a servant."
it: Un mostro dal corpo mezzo umano e mezzo serpente, che porta dentro di sé una scheggia della dea. In cambio delle sue profezie pretende un sacrificio, ma la vittima che le piace la lascia in vita e se la tiene accanto come serva.

jp: 集団で一撃離脱を繰り返す戦法を得意とする。1羽2羽では大して脅威にはならずチュンチュン鳴いてるだけで可愛いものだが、3羽以上揃うと牙をむく。
jp_grezzo: "集団で一撃離脱を繰り返す戦法を得意とする。1羽2羽では大して脅威にはならずチュンチュン鳴いてるだけで可愛いものだが、3羽以上揃うと牙をむく。"
en: With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs.
en_grezzo: "With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs."
it: La sua tattica è muoversi in gruppo, colpire e sfilarsi via, e ripetere. Uno o due non sono una gran minaccia: cinguettano e basta, e fanno pure tenerezza. Ma da tre in su tirano fuori le zanne.

jp: 異星出身のスパゲッティのような怪物。人の頭の上に触手を乗せて休憩する習性がある。この怪物との出会いが、とあるパロディ宗教が生まれるヒントとなった…という説がある。
jp_grezzo: "異星出身のスパゲッティのような怪物。人の頭の上に触手を乗せて休憩する習性がある。この怪物との出会いが、とあるパロディ宗教が生まれるヒントとなった…という説がある。"
en: With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs.
en_grezzo: "With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs."
it: Un mostro venuto da un altro pianeta, fatto a forma di spaghetti. Ha il vizio di posare i tentacoli sulla testa della gente e mettersi lì a riposare. C'è chi sostiene che sia stato l'incontro con questo mostro a dare l'idea da cui è nata una certa religione per burla.

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種にしてワイバーンの最終形態。狙撃と連射を得意とし、瞬く閃光のように次々にターゲットを撃ち抜いていく。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種にしてワイバーンの最終形態。狙撃と連射を得意とし、瞬く閃光のように次々にターゲットを撃ち抜いていく。"
en: A spaghetti-like monster from a different universe. It has a habit of resting its tentacles on a person's head. There is a theory that this encounter with the monster was a catalyst for the birth of a parody religion...
en_grezzo: "A spaghetti-like monster from a different universe. It has a habit of resting its tentacles on a person's head. There is a theory that this encounter with the monster was a catalyst for the birth of a parody religion..."
it: È una sottospecie di drago nata lungo la strada dell'evoluzione, ed è la forma ultima della viverna. Va forte nel tiro di precisione e nel tiro rapido, e trapassa un bersaglio dopo l'altro come lampi che si susseguono.

jp: あらゆる障害物を突破しあらゆる場所に機器や兵員を送り込む目的で開発された。正式機とは違い次元歪曲ユニットは完全内蔵式。
jp_grezzo: "あらゆる障害物を突破しあらゆる場所に機器や兵員を送り込む目的で開発された。正式機とは違い次元歪曲ユニットは完全内蔵式。"
en: The final form of Wyvern as a subspecies of the dragon that was born in the process of evolution. They excel at sniping and firing shooting out targets one after another like a flash of light.
en_grezzo: "The final form of Wyvern as a subspecies of the dragon that was born in the process of evolution. They excel at sniping and firing shooting out targets one after another like a flash of light."
it: È stata sviluppata per sfondare qualunque ostacolo e portare macchinari e uomini in qualunque posto. A differenza del modello definitivo, l'unità che piega le dimensioni è interamente incorporata.

jp: エルンという種類の妖精。姿を自在に消すことができ、神出鬼没。幾人もの冒険者が駆け出し時代に彼にガイドされているが、いつの間にか目にすることがなくなるという。
jp_grezzo: "エルンという種類の妖精。姿を自在に消すことができ、神出鬼没。幾人もの冒険者が駆け出し時代に彼にガイドされているが、いつの間にか目にすることがなくなるという。"
en: It was developed for the purpose of breaking through every obstacle and sending equipment and troops to every location. Unlike the official model the dimensional distortion unit is completely built-in.
en_grezzo: "It was developed for the purpose of breaking through every obstacle and sending equipment and troops to every location. Unlike the official model the dimensional distortion unit is completely built-in."
it: Una fata della stirpe degli Eln. Sa sparire a piacimento, e compare e scompare dove meno te lo aspetti. Un'infinità di avventurieri, ai tempi in cui muovevano i primi passi, si sono fatti guidare da lui; poi, senza accorgersene, smettono di vederlo.

jp: きのこのような姿形をもつ悪魔。煩悩の化身であり、人々を惑わし堕落させようと画策する。興奮すると頭部から怪しいぬちゃぬちゃした液体を噴出する。
jp_grezzo: "きのこのような姿形をもつ悪魔。煩悩の化身であり、人々を惑わし堕落させようと画策する。興奮すると頭部から怪しいぬちゃぬちゃした液体を噴出する。"
en: A kind of fairy called Erun. He can disappear at will and is omnipresent. A number of adventurers have been guided by him in his fledgling days but he says that at some point he will cease to be seen.
en_grezzo: "A kind of fairy called Erun. He can disappear at will and is omnipresent. A number of adventurers have been guided by him in his fledgling days but he says that at some point he will cease to be seen."
it: Un demone che ha la forma di un fungo. È l'incarnazione dei desideri terreni, e trama per confondere gli uomini e portarli alla rovina. Quando si eccita, dalla testa gli sprizza fuori un liquido sospetto e appiccicoso.

jp: 重迫撃砲を搭載した車両。機動性と速射性に優れるうえにコストも低いため量産されている。迫撃砲ゆえに射程が短いのが短所。基本的に完全自動化されているが、一応搭乗スペースがある。
jp_grezzo: "重迫撃砲を搭載した車両。機動性と速射性に優れるうえにコストも低いため量産されている。迫撃砲ゆえに射程が短いのが短所。基本的に完全自動化されているが、一応搭乗スペースがある。"
en: A demon with a mushroom-like form. It is the incarnation of suffering and schemes to deceive and corrupt people. When aroused a suspiciously squishy liquid gushes from its head.
en_grezzo: "A demon with a mushroom-like form. It is the incarnation of suffering and schemes to deceive and corrupt people. When aroused a suspiciously squishy liquid gushes from its head."
it: Un veicolo che monta un mortaio pesante. È mobile, spara rapido e costa poco, e per questo lo producono in serie. Il difetto è la gittata corta, ma è pur sempre un mortaio. Di norma fa tutto da solo, però un posto per l'equipaggio ce l'ha.

jp: 元ロックスロアー。石を投げる側に回ったのはいいが、石をぶつけても平然としている者が多いことに逆切れし、グレネードに持ち替えた。
jp_grezzo: "元ロックスロアー。石を投げる側に回ったのはいいが、石をぶつけても平然としている者が多いことに逆切れし、グレネードに持ち替えた。"
en: The vehicle is equipped with a heavy mortar gun. It is mass-produced because of its superior mobility and rapid-fire capabilities and its low cost. A disadvantage of the mortar is that it has a short range. Basically it is fully automated but there is still space for passengers.
en_grezzo: "The vehicle is equipped with a heavy mortar gun. It is mass-produced because of its superior mobility and rapid-fire capabilities and its low cost. A disadvantage of the mortar is that it has a short range. Basically it is fully automated but there is still space for passengers."
it: Era un lanciapietre. Passare dalla parte di chi le pietre le tira era stata una bella soddisfazione, se non che troppi se le prendevano in faccia senza scomporsi: si è arrabbiato, e ha cambiato le pietre con le granate.

jp: １号機のデータを元に作られた量産タイプ。コストを抑えるために武装や装甲には汎用性のあるものを採用。いくつかのシステムもオミットされている。
jp_grezzo: "１号機のデータを元に作られた量産タイプ。コストを抑えるために武装や装甲には汎用性のあるものを採用。いくつかのシステムもオミットされている。"
en: He was a former Rock Thrower. He went around to the stone throwing side which was fine but he snapped at the fact that so many of them were unfazed by the stones he was throwing at them and switched to grenades.
en_grezzo: "He was a former Rock Thrower. He went around to the stone throwing side which was fine but he snapped at the fact that so many of them were unfazed by the stones he was throwing at them and switched to grenades."
it: Il modello di serie, costruito sui dati del primo prototipo. Per tenere bassi i costi gli hanno montato armi e corazze di tipo comune, e qualche sistema di bordo gliel'hanno proprio tolto.

jp: 背中に外殻と一体化した蒸気タービンを持ち、そこから弾丸を高速射出する。一度絶滅しておりレム・イドの時代に復元されたが、無敵とされた丈夫な外殻は再現できなかった。
jp_grezzo: "背中に外殻と一体化した蒸気タービンを持ち、そこから弾丸を高速射出する。一度絶滅しておりレム・イドの時代に復元されたが、無敵とされた丈夫な外殻は再現できなかった。"
en: It has a steam turbine on its back that is integrated with its outer shell from which it ejects bullets at high speed. Once extinct and restored in the time of the Rehmido it was unable to recreate the sturdy outer shell that was considered invincible.
en_grezzo: "It has a steam turbine on its back that is integrated with its outer shell from which it ejects bullets at high speed. Once extinct and restored in the time of the Rehmido it was unable to recreate the sturdy outer shell that was considered invincible."
it: Sulla schiena porta una turbina a vapore fusa col guscio esterno, e da lì spara proiettili ad altissima velocità. Una volta si era estinto, e ai tempi di Rehm-Ido lo hanno riportato in vita; il guscio robusto che lo rendeva imbattibile, però, non sono riusciti a rifarlo.

jp: エーテルを好む、偉大なる竜の上位種にして竜の暴君。その咆哮は周囲の魔物も狂暴化させる。しょっちゅう怒っているためエネルギーを消耗し、やせ細っている。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルを好む、偉大なる竜の上位種にして竜の暴君。その咆哮は周囲の魔物も狂暴化させる。しょっちゅう怒っているためエネルギーを消耗し、やせ細っている。"
en: Ether-loving high ranking species of great dragons and dragon tyrants. The roar also makes the surrounding demons go berserk. It is frequently angry draining its strength and making it emaciated.
en_grezzo: "Ether-loving high ranking species of great dragons and dragon tyrants. The roar also makes the surrounding demons go berserk. It is frequently angry draining its strength and making it emaciated."
it: Ama l'etere, sta un gradino sopra i grandi draghi ed è il tiranno della sua stirpe. Il suo ruggito fa infuriare anche i mostri che gli stanno attorno. Siccome è arrabbiato praticamente sempre, consuma energia in continuazione ed è ridotto pelle e ossa.
